name: bc-xliff-language-map
description: Translation-memory .lng files, XLIFF repair and VS Code AI fallback for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central AL apps.

commands.title: BC XLIFF: Fill Missing Translations in Current File
BC XLIFF: Select Translation AI Model
BC XLIFF: Merge Translations Between Files

bcXliffLanguageMap.xliffGlob.description: Glob used to find translation XLIFF files.

bcXliffLanguageMap.excludeGlob.description: Glob excluded from XLIFF processing. The generated .g.xlf should normally stay excluded.

bcXliffLanguageMap.treatNeedsTranslation.description: Treat XLIFF targets with states such as needs-translation/needs-review/new as missing.

bcXliffLanguageMap.setTranslatedState.description: Set filled target elements to state=translated.

bcXliffLanguageMap.ai.enabled.description: Use a VS Code language model only after no Developer-comment translation and no companion .lng match was found.

bcXliffLanguageMap.ai.vendor.description: Preferred VS Code language-model vendor. Leave empty to allow any vendor.

bcXliffLanguageMap.ai.modelId.description: Optional exact model id. Use the Select Translation AI Model command to set it.

bcXliffLanguageMap.ai.batchSize.description: Number of source strings per AI translation request.

bcXliffLanguageMap.validation.checkDupli.description: Warn and skip a file when it contains duplicate trans-unit ids or duplicate Xliff Generator notes.

bcXliffLanguageMap.validation.checkMaxWi.description: Warn when a filled target text is longer than the trans-unit's maxwidth attribute.

bcXliffLanguageMap.fuzzyMatch.enabled.description: Fall back to the closest similarity match in the companion .lng file when no exact match exists. Applied translations are flagged state=needs-review-translation for human review.

bcXliffLanguageMap.fuzzyMatch.minimumQua.description: Minimum similarity percentage (Levenshtein-based) required to accept a fuzzy translation-memory match.

bcXliffLanguageMap.sourceChangeDetection.description: Compare already-translated trans-units against the sibling *.g.xlf file by id and flag state=needs-l10n when the source text changed.
